description: Hand-labeled graph-adjacency eval fixture for the phase-3 ranking boost. Records form ten small clusters of a knowledge graph: a design or concept that carries the topic vocabulary, plus the decision, task, proof, or reference that answers a question ABOUT that topic while using almost none of its words. Each pair is labeled `adjacency` (the expected record is reachable in one hop from a record the text rankers find easily) or `control` (the expected record wins on its own text and the boost must not displace it). A boost that lifts adjacency pairs while moving control pairs is not an improvement, so both are reported separately. Slug prefix eval-graph- is reserved so seeding and teardown cannot collide with real records. Harness: scripts/eval-graph-boost.ts.

records.title: Octopus — multi-region cache invalidation
records.body:
Design for invalidating a distributed cache across geographic regions when a write lands in one shard. Walks the fan-out broadcast pattern, the back-channel, and the failure mode where a region misses the broadcast and serves a stale read until the next full sweep.

Settled in [[decided-in::eval-graph-octopus-decision]]. Built by [[owns::eval-graph-octopus-task]].

records.title: Broadcast, not poll
records.body:
We take the push path. Polling was rejected on cost. Reviewed 2026-02-11.

[[references::eval-graph-octopus-design]]

records.title: Wire the back-channel listener
records.body:
Add the listener and the retry ladder. Two weeks. Owner: platform.

[[implements::eval-graph-octopus-design]]

records.title: Region miss reproduced
records.body:
Bench log from the staging sweep. 3 of 400 writes missed a region; the sweep caught all three within 90 seconds.

[[proves::eval-graph-octopus-design]]

records.title: Backpressure when producers outpace consumers
records.body:
What backpressure means in a streaming pipeline: the consumer signals the producer to slow down instead of dropping messages or growing an unbounded queue. Covers the credit scheme, the watermark, and why an unbounded buffer is a deferred outage.

Applied in [[references::eval-graph-canyon-design]].

records.title: Credit-based flow control for the ingest path
records.body:
Each consumer issues credits. The producer may send only what it holds credit for. Credits refresh on acknowledgement.

[[part-of::eval-graph-canyon-concept]]

records.title: Drop the unbounded queue
records.body:
Removed. It was the outage on 2026-01-30. No replacement queue without a bound.

[[decided-in::eval-graph-canyon-design]]

records.title: TLS termination at the edge load balancer
records.body:
Terminate TLS at the edge rather than at each service. Covers certificate rotation, the SNI routing table, and the mutual-TLS hop from the edge to the mesh.

Superseded by [[supersedes::eval-graph-jaguar-v2-design]].

records.title: Second pass on edge termination
records.body:
Replaces the first design. Moves rotation to the secret store and drops the SNI table in favour of the mesh's own routing.

[[references::eval-graph-jaguar-design]]

records.title: Rotate signing keys quarterly
records.body:
Quarterly rotation, tracked on the calendar. Owner: security.

[[implements::eval-graph-jaguar-design]]

records.title: Why search returns junk after deletes
records.body:
Investigation into deleted records still appearing in search results. Traces the stale vector fragments left behind by a soft delete and the index that never reclaims them.

[[references::eval-graph-iceberg-concept]]

records.title: Tombstones and index reclamation
records.body:
A soft delete writes a tombstone. Reclamation is a separate pass. Until it runs, the fragment is still addressable.

[[part-of::eval-graph-iceberg-spike]]

records.title: Reclaim fragments on the delete path
records.body:
Make the delete path enqueue reclamation instead of waiting for the nightly pass.

[[implements::eval-graph-iceberg-spike]]

records.title: Deleted records no longer returned
records.body:
Run log, 2026-03-04. 200 deletes, 0 stale hits at 60 seconds.

[[proves::eval-graph-iceberg-task]]

records.title: Rate limiting middleware with a token bucket
records.body:
Token-bucket middleware in front of the public API. Covers the refill rate, the burst allowance, and the per-tenant key.

Settled in [[decided-in::eval-graph-ravine-decision]]. Built by [[owns::eval-graph-ravine-task]].

records.title: Per tenant, not per IP
records.body:
Keyed on the tenant. IP keying was rejected: shared egress made it punish the wrong caller.

[[references::eval-graph-ravine-design]]

records.title: Add the middleware to the public router
records.body:
Insert ahead of authentication so an unauthenticated flood is cheap to reject.

[[implements::eval-graph-ravine-design]]

records.title: Websocket reconnection with exponential backoff
records.body:
Why clients reconnect in a thundering herd after a deploy, and how jittered exponential backoff spreads them. Includes the measured herd from the 2026-02 deploy.

[[references::eval-graph-quasar-decision]]

records.title: Full jitter
records.body:
Full jitter, not equal jitter. Measured 4x lower peak on the same herd.

[[decided-in::eval-graph-quasar-spike]]

records.title: Ship the jittered client
records.body:
Client library change plus a version gate so old clients keep the old ladder.

[[implements::eval-graph-quasar-spike]]

records.title: Back of envelope capacity planning
records.body:
How to size a service before it exists: request rate, payload size, fan-out factor, and the headroom multiplier. Worked example for a read-heavy API.

[[references::eval-graph-tundra-reference]]

records.title: Latency numbers every engineer should know
records.body:
The standard table. Memory, SSD, same-datacenter round trip, cross-continent round trip.

[[part-of::eval-graph-tundra-concept]]

records.title: Q3 search latency improvement
records.body:
Cut p95 search latency. Three workstreams: index shape, cache warming, and query planning.

[[references::eval-graph-tundra-concept]]

records.title: Kanban orchestrator
records.body:
Agent that manages task lifecycle on the board: claims a card, drives it to a merged change, and closes it with proof.

[[references::eval-graph-gondola-design]]

records.title: Card lifecycle and the claim protocol
records.body:
How a card moves through the columns, what a claim means, and the compare-and-set that prevents two workers claiming one card.

[[owns::eval-graph-gondola-agent]]

records.title: Incident response runbook executor
records.body:
Reads a runbook and executes its steps, pausing at every step marked human-only.

[[references::eval-graph-walrus-preference]]

records.title: Pause at human-only steps
records.body:
Never execute a step marked human-only, even when the step looks mechanical.

[[part-of::eval-graph-walrus-agent]]

records.title: Never silently swallow errors
records.body:
An error that is caught and dropped is a defect with no report. Log it, wrap it, or let it propagate — never an empty catch.

[[references::eval-graph-elder-concept]]

records.title: Error propagation and the empty catch
records.body:
Why an empty catch block is worse than a crash: the crash is observable.

[[part-of::eval-graph-elder-preference]]

records.title: Pin dependencies in the lockfile
records.body:
No floating versions. The lockfile is the build input; a range is a build that changes without a commit.

[[references::eval-graph-umbra-reference]]

records.title: Lockfile formats across ecosystems
records.body:
How each package manager records a resolved tree, and which of them are reproducible.

[[part-of::eval-graph-umbra-preference]]

records.title: OpenTelemetry attribute naming
records.body:
The semantic-convention attribute names and the rules for adding your own without colliding with a future convention.

[[part-of::eval-graph-violet-design]]

records.title: Trace attribute policy for the fleet
records.body:
Which attributes every span must carry, which are forbidden because they are high cardinality, and where the allowlist lives.

[[references::eval-graph-violet-reference]]

records.title: Enforce the allowlist in the exporter
records.body:
Reject a span that carries an attribute outside the list, and count the rejection.

[[implements::eval-graph-violet-design]]
